decisions.reason: The three-second attention window is a hook constraint and does not change the existing lead-generation objective or target CPL.
The hook timing does not alter the requirement to use the winning creative's validated structural principles as a reference.
The attention-capture window does not change the source or format of testimonial content.
A three-second opening hook does not change the video's count, total duration, or required aspect ratios.
The hook timing does not modify the required UGC visual style or realism criteria.
The opening-hook timing does not change the freelancer's full-service production responsibility or supplied production elements.
The video opening-hook constraint does not affect the deferred landing-page and tracking audit.
